scope: runtime modules only; no Pi Web host installation

local_patches.summary: readModels refreshes the provider catalog once when the first answer is empty or an error (carried from upstream pull request 9) Alpine fallback requires a musl-compatible native runtime and delegates its verified build to the packaged helper; absent build tools fail with RUNTIME_NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE. Pairing offers are transient return values; legacy private offer files are removed. Runtime installation disables all dependency lifecycle scripts except the explicitly reviewed node-pty rebuild and executable checks.
Exact @getpaseo/cli 0.17.5 lock with audited overrides: MCP SDK 1.32.2, @hono/node-server 2.1.11, hono 4.13.23, markdown-it 14.3.3, ai 5.0.207 and uuid 11.1.1.
Managed runtime upgraded to exact @getpaseo/cli 0.17.5 with explicit audited security/compatibility overrides.
Added fixed official, WoowTech and Apporo connection profiles with atomic app/relay/CORS/security configuration and strict decoded pairing-offer validation.
Immutable 0.17.5 r2 receipt verifies brand patch/helper hashes, with strict legacy 0.11.2 recognition for owned-daemon control and rollback.

Added file: usingAcceptanceWorkspace creates one workspace for an acceptance run, archives it afterwards and confirms it left the project's workspace list, recording the outcome as workspaceCleanup on the result row.
withLock takes an optional helper and passes it on to withLockTransition so a caller can select the hash-pinned Python flock helper.

providerReplyError also classifies billing, insufficient-credit and payment-required replies as PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, and the new providerTurnError maps a failed turn to a fixed error code without keeping its message.
Added file: safeChatResult wraps chatResult so a failed, timed-out or permission-blocked provider turn returns only a fixed status or code, never the provider's partial reply or error text.
withLockTransition can run a hash-pinned Python flock helper (the helper option or PI_PASEO_FLOCK_HELPER, sha256 f178c22c...) through /usr/bin/python3 instead of util-linux flock.
Locally selected connection target supplies the daemon hello brand; unknown targets fail closed.
Hash-pinned @getpaseo/server 0.17.5 patch adds only the optional server_info brand field required by branded Apps; unknown source bytes are rejected.
